_about: Expected result for every authority and quotation in tests/drafts. 'error' describes the planted mistake; null means the item is correct. 'expect' lists the statuses that count as the right answer. Expectations are for the offline demo library; with the live API an invented citation may also come back as NAME_MISMATCH or NEEDS_REVIEW if the volume and page happen to belong to a real case.
